origin.thread_label: Alpha Lab Project-to-CA Intelligence Bridge shadow build P1

title: Project-to-CA bridge P1 persistent project memory substrate
objective: Implement only P1 of the frozen Project-to-CA shadow build: the smallest child project-memory schema/adapter and focused tests needed to persist a unique eligible project trial before any token exists, while reusing existing Meme Alpha prospective evidence and runtime owners and preserving the frozen A/B/C experiment.

evidence.summary: Accepted Deep Research endpoint and frozen A/B/C preregistration.
Existing prospective/outcome owner. No-token matches count in denominator and frozen lineage is required.
Existing exact-CA token lifecycle owner. Project identity must remain separate from this token identity.
Existing runtime/source-authentication/budget authority. No new scheduler or runtime owner.
Existing evidence discipline requires frozen input immutability, lineage, duplicate controls and no retrospective eligibility.

reproduction: On fresh main, verify the frozen #1180/#1181 contracts require persistent project memory before token existence, then inspect existing Meme Alpha schemas/runtime. There is no existing child project-memory substrate that can represent a unique eligible project trial with point-in-time source snapshots, aliases without identity authority, no-token persistence, token-state progression and append-only/superseded history. Do not treat this absence as permission to create a parallel ledger or scanner.

positive: A no-token eligible project can be frozen and persisted with stable project_trial_id, method_version, frozen_at_utc, eligibility_manifest_sha256, discovery, project_identity, source_observations, project_memory_before, material_delta, token_state, CA candidates, lineage and authority.

Repeated observations that resolve to the same authenticated/bounded project lineage do not create a second denominator trial merely because alias, URL ordering or non-semantic field ordering differs.
Source observations preserve exact observed_at, available_at where known, source/content hash and authentication/conflict state.
Historical observations are append-only or explicitly superseded with lineage. No silent rewrite.
8-Ball-style serious project with NO_TOKEN_OBSERVED persists as an eligible project trial and remains available for later material-change handling.
HoodStack-style contradictory mutable sources preserve both timestamped observations and conflict state rather than choosing the newest-looking prose.
Focused deterministic tests pass and prove no outcome field is required to create/freeze project memory.
negative: Ticker, project name, logo or alias alone cannot establish project identity or token identity.
Pons/factory token occurrence cannot by itself convert project memory into a project-to-CA BOUND_HIGH relation. P2 semantics remain unimplemented.
No new scanner, scheduler, standalone ledger, scoring engine, alert path or learning owner is introduced.
No JEV behavior, A/B/C thresholds, survival margins, denominator classes, market gates, model weights, API budget, portfolio logic or production authority changes.
NET, SAFIX and DARK cannot increment prospective performance counters through P1 fixtures.
Missing source data remains UNKNOWN and cannot become zero, false or negative evidence.
P1 must not implement P2-P6 opportunistically.
